meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: Claude 不再整文件读代码,而是先做语法结构分析:按关键词找到相关文件和符号,再看单文件骨架,最后只展开需要的函数源码。
howto.when: 当需要理解代码结构、查找函数或高效探索代码库时触发,优先使用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold,而非 Read/Grep/Glob。

say.text: 帮我找一下 shutdown 相关的函数在哪
say.note: 会先搜目录,列出匹配符号和文件。

say.text: 这个文件里有哪些函数?
say.note: 会生成文件结构骨架,而非整篇读取。

say.text: 展开 worker-service.ts 里 shutdown 的源码
say.note: 只展开该符号的完整实现。

howto.what_en: Claude stops reading whole files first. It uses AST-based structural search: locate files and symbols by query, view a file's skeleton, then unfold only the needed function's source.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs code structure, function lookup, or efficient codebase exploration; Claude uses smart_search/smart_outline/smart_unfold instead of Read/Grep/Glob.

say_en.text: Find the functions related to "shutdown" for me.
say_en.note: It searches the directory and lists matching symbols and files.

say_en.text: What functions are in this file?
say_en.note: It returns the structural skeleton instead of the whole file.

say_en.text: Show the source of shutdown in worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: It unfolds only that symbol's implementation.
